title: Caridad Sanchez's daughter shares touching moment amid actress' Alzheimer’s
summary: Writer and Palanca awardee Cathy Babao received an early birthday gift after her veteran actress mom Caridad Sanchez, who has been living with Alzheimer’s disease, briefly remembered her after nearly…

blocks.text: Writer and Palanca awardee Cathy Babao received an early birthday gift after her veteran actress mom Caridad Sanchez, who has been living with Alzheimer’s disease, briefly remembered her after nearly a year. Babao gave a glimpse of their moment through her Instagram page on Sunday, Oct. 11, and spoke about her elation over the “most precious gift [she] could ever ask for.” “Five days before my birthday, the Lord gave me the most precious gift I could ever ask for. Tonight, Mommy was there. Truly, unmistakably there,” Babao said. “It has been almost a year since I last saw her this […]...
